record.provider: DataONE Hosted Repository (TACC / UC Santa Barbara)

free_tier.stated: none: the only tier with storage, the Hosted Repository, is priced at ~$1285.14 /mo, billed annually. DataONE Member and DataONE Plus are listed as Free with no stated byte allowance.

egress.terms: Not separately metered; included in the subscription.

record.tooling: Metacat + MetacatUI (open source, self-hostable); DataONE Member Node REST API for programmatic deposit and read.
record.chaining: Per repository, so multiple repositories = multiple subscriptions at the same list price. Useful mainly as the market price for what the free programmes give away.

limits.value: 1 TB repository capacity, expandable in 1 TB increments

record.limits_note: Paid: ~$1,285.14/month billed annually. DataONE Member and DataONE Plus tiers are free but provide no storage of your own - Member is for repositories you already run, Plus is a portal/FAIR-reporting layer ('upload any file format' refers to portal ingestion, not a byte grant).

identity_cost.detail: The Hosted Repository request form requires an e-mail address and DataONE follows up to set the repository up; the payment method for the annual billing is not published.

record.reliability_note: All data and metadata are replicated to two geographically independent data centers in California and Tennessee.
record.confidence_note: the vendor pages of the 2026-11-03 evidence rows were read and captured (https://www.dataone.org/services/, https://www.dataone.org/hosted-repo/, https://www.dataone.org/jointhenetwork/); every field that decides the verdict cites one of those captures
